title: Raycast Pricing 2026: Full Guide to Plans and Costs
summary: Raycast pricing structures for 2026 help users evaluate whether the free tier suffices or if a Pro or Team subscription provides necessary value.
body_markdown:
## Raycast pricing tiers for individuals and teams


### The Free tier: Core tools and local extensions


For a single user, the Free tier serves as the basic launcher. It keeps tools like the clipboard manager and system commands accessible without a recurring invoice. You can install community-developed extensions from the[Raycast](https://raycast.com/changelog/ios) Store to integrate with external services.


Bundling a specific model often forces a pre-set AI strategy onto your team, whereas Activepieces runs whichever model you have already selected (using your own provider key at your own rate) so the resulting model spend lands on your own provider account rather than a platform markup.


You can verify this Bring-Your-Own-Key availability by tier on the pricing page, which allows for direct cost control starting at the Plus plan.


Directly from your search bar, Activepieces triggers automated workflows. This tier is restricted to local storage, meaning your snippets and configuration don't follow you if you switch between a MacBook and an iMac.


### Raycast Pro: AI access and cloud sync


By centralizing AI interactions and settings across your multiple devices, Raycast Pro introduces a layer of managed services that justifies a monthly fee.


### Syncing settings versus advanced data


While the Free plan does not include cloud sync at all, Pro's 256-bit AES encrypted sync covers Snippets, Notes, and Chats but does not cover the heavy data generated by power users. This basic sync ensures your hotkeys and core preferences remain consistent across machines without a subscription.


Upgrading to Pro is required to synchronize more advanced data like your AI chat history, custom snippets, and clipboard history. Without the paid tier, these productivity assets remain locked to the specific Mac where they were created.


Subscribing to this tier grants you access to Raycast AI, which embeds models like GPT-6 Astra and Claude Sonnet 5.5 directly into the interface.


Without maintaining separate browser tabs, you can generate text or refactor code. The inclusion of encrypted cloud sync ensures that your custom snippets and extension settings are identical on every authorized machine.

Choosing between local utility and cloud-enhanced intelligence is the primary consequence of this pricing ladder.


### Raycast Team: Shared commands and knowledge management


Value shifts from individual speed to organizational consistency under the Team plan. It's a shared environment for your internal scripts and documentation. It allows you, as an operations lead, to publish "Quicklinks" and custom script commands to a private team store.


> Choosing between local utility and cloud-enhanced intelligence is the primary consequence of this pricing ladder.


Internal database lookups or project dashboards are handled by every employee using the same standardized shortcuts.
